_comment: DUBSTEP progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law -- docs/idiom-research/legal.md); these are the harmonic families from docs/idiom-research/genre-reggae-dub-bass.md section C2, weighted per its percentages. ALL minor by design: C2 says no major-key sections, no V7, no maj7. The phrygian i-bII family is not encodable as diatonic degrees, so the b2 dread lives in hooks (acc -1 lock) and bass (app dir -1) instead. Weights: i drone 40, i-bVI 25, i-bVI-bVII-i 15, i-v 5, plus the material.json bVII-neighbor loop.
